Since 1995, VULCAN has been driven by a singular vision: to be Australasia’s most customer-focused and efficient metals distributor. By delivering superior service, we’ve grown from a carbon steel specialist into an industrial leader.

Today, we provide precision solutions across plate and coil processing, stainless, and engineering steels. With 69 world-class facilities and a team of 1,300+, our strategic expansion ensures we have the scale and expertise to keep the Australasian economy moving.

We are seeking experienced and qualified CNC PROGRAMMER to join our team of hardworking professionals. In this role, you will be responsible for preparing, developing, and optimising programs for Daito CNC Beam Lines and CNC Bandsaws to support accurate, efficient, and safe processing of steel sections.

Your key responsibilities include but will not be limited to:

CNC Programming
Generate CNC programs for Daito Beam Lines and CNC Bandsaws.
Import and prepare DSTV/NC1 files.
Validate machining features including drilling, marking, slotting, and cut lengths.
Apply correct tools, offsets, speeds, and feeds.
Optimise cutting and nesting sequences.
Conduct simulation checks.

Production Integration

Quality & Compliance

Support first-off inspections.

Continuous Improvement

Technical Skills
Experience with Daito Beam Line programming and CNC Bandsaws.

Ability to read engineering drawings.
Knowledge of steel profiles.

Professional Competencies:
High attention to detail
Strong problem-solving
Effective communication
Organised and reliable
Safety-focused

About the Role:
C&J Fabrications is seeking a qualified and experienced Pressure Welder to join our fabrication and manufacturing operations in Australia. The successful candidate will perform high-quality pressure welding on pipes, vessels, structural components, and heavy fabrication equipment according to Australian Standards, engineering specifications, and workplace safety requirements. This role is crucial in supporting operational demands within the manufacturing and engineering sector, where suitably qualified Australian workers have not been available despite genuine recruitment efforts.

Key Duties & Responsibilities:
- Perform pressure welding using MIG, TIG, FCAW, Stick, and other welding techniques.
- Weld pressure pipes, tanks, boilers, and structural steel components.
- Interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, and welding procedures.
- Operate welding equipment and fabrication machinery safely and efficiently.
- Conduct weld preparation, grinding, gouging, cutting, and finishing.
- Inspect completed welds for structural integrity and quality compliance.
- Perform welding in accordance with AS/NZS welding standards and site specifications.
- Maintain workshop safety and comply with WHS requirements.
- Complete fabrication and repair work within project deadlines.
- Participate in shutdowns, maintenance projects, and site installations as required.

Minimum Requirements:

Qualifications:
- Relevant Trade Qualification equivalent to:
- Certificate III in Engineering – Fabrication Trade, or
- A recognized international welding trade qualification.
- Welding certifications are advantageous.

Experience:
- Minimum of 3 years of post-trade experience as a Pressure Welder.
- Experience in heavy fabrication, manufacturing, mining, oil & gas, or industrial environments is preferred.

Skills:
- Strong knowledge of pressure welding techniques.
- Ability to read and interpret technical drawings.
- Experience welding carbon steel, stainless steel, and alloy materials.
- Knowledge of Australian welding and safety standards.
- Strong problem-solving and communication skills.

Carpenter (ANZSCO 331212) – Full-Time Position

Kodi Construction Group Pty Ltd is a Queensland-based construction company currently seeking a qualified and experienced Carpenter to join our team on a full-time basis.

Location: Queensland, Australia (Brisbane, Logan, Gold Coast and surrounding areas)

This is a genuine full-time position required for the ongoing operations of the business.

Position Overview:
We are looking for a skilled Carpenter to perform a wide range of construction and carpentry tasks across residential and small commercial projects. The role requires a high level of workmanship, reliability, and the ability to work both independently and within a team.

Key Responsibilities:
- Construct, install and repair structures and fixtures made from timber and other materials
- Measure, cut, shape and assemble materials according to plans and specifications
- Interpret technical drawings and building plans
- Install decking, framing, pergolas, roofing structures and general carpentry works
- Ensure all work complies with Australian building standards and regulations
- Maintain tools and equipment in safe working condition
- Follow all Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) requirements
- Work efficiently to meet project deadlines

Requirements:
- Certificate III in Carpentry (or equivalent qualification)
- Minimum 2 years relevant work experience
- Ability to read and interpret plans
- White Card (mandatory)
- Driver’s licence and reliable transport
- Strong attention to detail and quality workmanship

Pre & Post-Scan Assessments: Conduct exhaustive pre-scan assessments to map crash impact damage and post-scan vehicle assessments to certify mechanical safety before delivery.  System Calibration & Configuration: Execute precise calibration and configuration of advanced electronic vehicle systems, including Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) such as radar, cameras, proximity sensors, and airbag modules. Maintenance & Repair Execution: Perform mechanical assembly/disassembly, routine, and emergency maintenance on mechanical assemblies, steering geometry, suspension components, and hydraulic systems impacted by collision forces.  Procurement Support: Prepare highly accurate parts lists, component requirements, and specialized technical repair specifications.  Quality Control & Compliance: Perform strict quality control inspections post-repair, verifying exact component alignment, fitment, and electronic functionality.  Workshop Technical Support: Provide active technical guidance to panel beating and body-repair staff during vehicle strip and refit operations.  Documentation: Fully document diagnostic data, calibration results, and repair procedures to maintain compliance with safety and insurance frameworks.   Skills, Qualifications & Experience Required   Qualifications: A relevant formal qualification  Experience: A minimum of 2 to 3 years of hands-on experience working with complex  electromechanical assemblies, technical diagnostics, and system testing/calibration. Prior experience diagnosing faults using technical scanners and software is essential.    Skills:  Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to trouble shoot, investigate and rectify Exceptional ability to read and interpret complex technical drawings, mechanical designs, and electronic circuit paths. Strong diagnostic capabilities and a methodical approach to system calibration are required.
